semiconductor_relevance: High — Nagase provides a range of specialized materials and chemicals for semiconductor applications, including encapsulants and resists.
summary: Nagase offers a diverse portfolio of semiconductor materials, including liquid molding compounds for wafer-level packaging and advanced photoresists for fine patterning. Their innovations focus on enhancing reliability and productivity in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Liquid Molding Compound (LMC) for wafer-level packaging
Positive Lift-Off Resist for fine wire applications
